name: Mira Hofmann
imageAlt: Portrait of Mira Hofmann, yoga teacher for Hatha Yoga and meditation, in a white blouse
metaDescription: Mira Hofmann – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: Hatha Yoga, meditation. Calm, precise guidance for beginners and those returning to yoga.
quote: If you practice slowly, you get further than you think. I want you to leave class calmer than you arrived.
shortBio: Mira teaches Hatha Yoga and leads the meditation classes. She values clear guidance, precise alignment and an atmosphere in which nobody has anything to prove.
certifications: Multi-year yoga teacher training, further training in meditation instruction
bioSummary: Calm, precise guidance for beginners and those returning to yoga.
teachingStyle: Slow, precise, with plenty of room for the breath

philosophy.title: Mindfulness
philosophy.text: Every pose begins with feeling: Where am I right now, and what does my body need?

philosophy.title: Breath
philosophy.text: The breath sets the pace – not ambition.

philosophy.title: Alignment
philosophy.text: Clean basic poses protect the joints and make the practice sustainable.

name: Jonas Keller
imageAlt: Portrait of Jonas Keller, yoga teacher for Vinyasa Flow, in a grey T-shirt
metaDescription: Jonas Keller – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: Vinyasa Flow, Power Flow. Flowing classes for strength, flexibility and stamina.
quote: Movement and breath belong together. When both are flowing, the mind quiets down on its own.
shortBio: Jonas teaches Vinyasa Flow and Power Flow. His classes are dynamic but never hectic: every sequence is explained before it is put together.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, further training in sequencing
bioSummary: Flowing classes for strength, flexibility and stamina.

philosophy.title: Flow
philosophy.text: Transitions are just as important as the poses themselves.

philosophy.title: Strength
philosophy.text: Stability comes from the core and can be built up step by step.

philosophy.title: Joy
philosophy.text: If you enjoy moving, you stick with it.

benefits: Stamina for everyday life and sport

name: Lena Brandt
imageAlt: Portrait of Lena Brandt, yoga teacher for Yin Yoga and Restorative, with long hair
metaDescription: Lena Brandt – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: Yin Yoga, Restorative. Deep relaxation through long-held poses.
quote: Sometimes the bravest thing is simply to stay lying down and breathe.
shortBio: Lena teaches Yin Yoga and Restorative. In long, held poses she gives you time to let go of tension and come to rest.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, further training in Yin Yoga

philosophy.title: Letting go
philosophy.text: Not doing, but allowing: that is the real practice.

philosophy.title: Time
philosophy.text: Long-held poses work on tissue and mind at the same time.

philosophy.title: Support
philosophy.text: Blankets and bolsters make it easy to truly relax.

name: Arjun Mehta
imageAlt: Portrait of Arjun Mehta, yoga teacher for breathwork and pranayama, smiling
metaDescription: Arjun Mehta – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: pranayama, breathwork. Breathing techniques for composure and energy.
quote: Your breath is the one thing you always have with you. I will show you how to use it.
shortBio: Arjun leads the breathwork classes and the meditation evenings. He teaches pranayama techniques in a way that carries over easily into everyday life.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, further training in pranayama
bioSummary: Breathing techniques for composure and energy.

philosophy.title: Observing
philosophy.text: First notice, then change – that applies to the breath as much as to everyday life.

philosophy.title: Rhythm
philosophy.text: An even breath calms, a conscious breath wakes you up.

philosophy.title: Everyday life
philosophy.text: Every technique has to be practicable in a few minutes.

name: Hannah Vogel
imageAlt: Portrait of Hannah Vogel, yoga teacher with a focus on yoga therapy, laughing
metaDescription: Hannah Vogel – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: yoga therapy, Back & Breath. Gentle, targeted exercises for tension.
designation: Yoga teacher with a therapeutic focus
quote: A body that feels safe can let go. That is what we are here for.
shortBio: Hannah combines yoga with targeted exercises for back, neck and shoulders. She adapts poses individually – including when you have complaints.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, further training in therapeutic yoga

philosophy.title: Safety
philosophy.text: Every exercise can be adapted so that it feels good.

philosophy.title: Precision
philosophy.text: Small adjustments often make the biggest difference.

philosophy.title: Patience
philosophy.text: The body needs time to learn something new.

benefits: More flexibility in back and shoulders
Exercises for the office and at home
A trusting sense of your body

name: Tobias Reuter
imageAlt: Portrait of Tobias Reuter, yoga teacher for Ashtanga Yoga, in a white T-shirt
metaDescription: Tobias Reuter – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: Ashtanga Yoga. Powerful, structured practice for experienced practitioners.
quote: A fixed order gives freedom: when the sequence is in place, there is room for the breath.
shortBio: Tobias teaches Ashtanga Yoga early in the morning. He guides experienced practitioners step by step through the fixed series and explains every variation along the way.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, Ashtanga further training
bioSummary: Powerful, structured practice for experienced practitioners.

philosophy.title: Consistency
philosophy.text: Practicing a little every day gets you further than rare, long classes.

philosophy.title: Structure
philosophy.text: The fixed series gives support and makes progress visible.

philosophy.title: Breath
philosophy.text: Ujjayi breathing keeps body and mind in time.

benefits: A fixed rhythm for the morning

name: Sophie Lorenz
imageAlt: Portrait of Sophie Lorenz, yoga teacher for sound baths and deep relaxation
metaDescription: Sophie Lorenz – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: sound baths, deep relaxation. Relaxation with singing bowls and gong.
quote: Sound reaches us where words end.
shortBio: Sophie creates sound baths and relaxation evenings. With singing bowls and gong she accompanies the final relaxation and invites you to tune in to how you feel.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, further training in sound work
bioSummary: Relaxation with singing bowls and gong.

philosophy.title: Listening
philosophy.text: If you listen, you come to rest on your own.

philosophy.title: Space
philosophy.text: Silence is not a lack of sound, but room to perceive.

philosophy.title: Surrender
philosophy.text: Nothing has to, everything may.

benefits: Switching off after a long day
A gentle end to the week

name: Elias Sommer
imageAlt: Portrait of Elias Sommer, yoga teacher for beginner classes and Yoga Basics, smiling
metaDescription: Elias Sommer – yoga teacher at Inner Temple Yoga Retreat. Focus: Yoga Basics, beginner classes. An understandable start with no prior knowledge.
quote: Everyone starts somewhere. Here, starting is already the success.
shortBio: Elias looks after the beginner classes and Yoga Basics. He explains the basic poses clearly and shows how to adapt them to your own body.
certifications: Yoga teacher training, further training for beginner groups
bioSummary: An understandable start with no prior knowledge.
teachingStyle: Patient, clear, with plenty of explanation

philosophy.title: Simplicity
philosophy.text: Good practice does not need complicated poses.

philosophy.title: Variation
philosophy.text: Every exercise has an easier and a more challenging version.

philosophy.title: Curiosity
philosophy.text: Trying things out is allowed, comparing is not necessary.

benefits: A safe start with no prior knowledge
